chinatown.title: Safer crossing
chinatown.detail: Bollards, traffic calming and lighting define the pedestrian-priority entrance near Boulevard Saint-Laurent.

chinatown.title: Art and wayfinding
chinatown.detail: Painted pavement and murals connect side passages to the main street east of Rue Saint-Dominique.

chinatown.title: Outdoor activity
chinatown.detail: Table tennis, seating and clear circulation support informal gathering between Rue De Bullion and Avenue de l’Hôtel-de-Ville.

chinatown.title: Alley mural
chinatown.detail: A mural near Rue Sainte-Élisabeth marks an alley entrance and extends the corridor’s visual identity.

landuse.name: Residential
landuse.detail: The largest component of the proposed district, with residential buildings generally ranging from 3 to 4 storeys.

landuse.name: Mixed-use
landuse.detail: Housing and other activities share the district; mixed-use buildings are proposed at 5 to 6 storeys.

landuse.name: Institutional
landuse.detail: Institutional uses are concentrated toward the north in the team’s land-use strategy.

landuse.name: Industrial
landuse.detail: Industrial uses are concentrated toward the north to manage their relationship with housing.

landuse.name: Commercial
landuse.detail: The proposed Pierre-de-Coubertin commercial corridor connects to the tram and shared street.
